title: Batch 256 -> 512, lr 1e-3 -> 1.5e-3
description: Double the batch with a modest lr bump (sqrt-ish scaling). At bs 256 the 3.2M model is launch/memory-bound (92 ms/step for ~14 ms of math), so a step at 512 should cost well under 2x and the run sees more tokens.
hypothesis: More tokens per second at nearly the same step count in the early phase; better GPU utilisation. Risk: fewer optimizer steps (~1300) if the step time does scale.
surprise: Step time scaled linearly with batch (~1100 steps), so the model is compute-bound at bs 256 after all; fewer updates -> greedy 0.85 -> metric 23. The profile's 92 ms/step is real GPU time for T~278 with padding, not launch overhead.
